message: SLA columns now fill in during a bulk load. Requests for SLA data were failing whenever a batch was larger than about 1300 tickets, which left the SLA columns — and the SLACompliance, AtRiskResponse, and AtRiskResolution sheets — blank. New copies of the template load tickets 1250 at a time and stay under that limit. If your SLA columns are blank, copy the current template. Do not set TICKET_BATCH_SIZE in Config above 1250.
